patterns: What does a data scientist do
responses: Data Science combines statistics, programming and domain knowledge to extract insights from data.
Data Science involves collecting, cleaning, analyzing and modeling data to support decisions.

patterns: How does a neural network work
responses: A neural network is a machine learning model made of interconnected units called neurons, organized into layers.
Neural networks learn patterns by adjusting weights during training.

patterns: What is a convolutional neural network
responses: A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is a deep learning model commonly used for image recognition and computer vision.
CNNs learn visual features such as edges, shapes and patterns from images.

patterns: How is an AI model trained
responses: Model training is the process of learning patterns from examples by adjusting model parameters.
An epoch is one complete pass through the training dataset.
